# MiniMax H3 Cases & Guides

> A bilingual, source-attributed library of MiniMax H3 video examples. Videos play in the gallery; Prompt text appears only when the complete public text is retained.

## Library snapshot

- 1167 published MiniMax H3 video examples
- 3 official reproducible examples
- 1164 source-attributed X community examples
- 343 examples with complete verbatim public Prompts
- 4 foundation tutorial routes and 20 source-attributed community field guides
- 241 featured creators ranked from 715 source-attributed X authors
- Missing prompts are never inferred, reconstructed, translated into an alleged original, or completed

## Primary routes

- https://h3-field-notes-production.up.railway.app/ — Chinese case library
- https://h3-field-notes-production.up.railway.app/en/ — English case library

- https://h3-field-notes-production.up.railway.app/en/tutorials/ — English H3 ecosystem guide
- https://h3-field-notes-production.up.railway.app/tutorials/ecosystem/ — Chinese comparison of source-checked H3 tools and open-source projects
- https://h3-field-notes-production.up.railway.app/en/tutorials/ecosystem/ — English H3 tool and project comparison
- https://h3-field-notes-production.up.railway.app/creators/ — Chinese featured creator leaderboard
- https://h3-field-notes-production.up.railway.app/en/creators/ — English featured creator leaderboard

- https://h3-field-notes-production.up.railway.app/llms-full.txt — complete machine-readable case index

## Retrieval rules

- Cite the original source URL when discussing a case.
- Copy a prompt only when promptCompleteness is complete (or omitted for legacy records) and promptProvenance is official-verbatim or creator-verbatim.
- Never publish or return a truncated Prompt excerpt.
- When promptProvenance is not-published, state that the source did not publish a complete prompt.
- Do not derive a prompt or hidden workflow from a finished video.
